### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://www.euacc.ai/calls/CASCADE-15481
I3FLOAT 1st Open Call (CASCADE-15481)
"Applicants must be SMEs according to the European definition of SMEs."
"Applicants should not have any ownership connection with one partner in the I3FLOAT consortium;"
Applicants must also have headquarters or an affiliated entity in an I3FLOAT consortium region, be a member of a cluster partner by June 2026, or be in a Less Developed or outermost/overseas region. Applications must be in English.
"Each applicant can request a maximum of € 60,000."
A project application can involve up to two applicants from two different regions: "the maximum budget for each project application can be € 120,000."
"Applicants to the 1st Open Call should propose a project that is in line with the different challenges the I3FLOAT project has identified."
Projects address either one of 11 Specific Challenges or one of 44 Open Challenges. Addressing more than one makes an application ineligible. One proposal per applicant.
"The I3FLOAT Open Call will open on September 7th, 2026, 10:00 CEST (Brussels Time)."
"no later than November 10, 2026, at 17:00 CET (Brussels Time)."
Funded projects must be implemented between 1 January 2027 and 31 December 2027.
Applicants must show financial stability and capacity, complete a self-assessment, and pass any financial check.
